## Claim & Evidence

**Claim:** 龙涎香 (lóngxiánxiāng) is a Chinese incense ingredient (animal-derived, not botanical) — ambergris, a sperm whale (Physeter macrocephalus) secretion — with an aroma profile of marine, sweet, earthy, waxy. Most 'ambergris' today is synthetic.
